'''Lullely''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Yawnelly]] at 6 bronze stars.

== Overview ==
Current Description: "Always looks half-asleep. Not from fatigue, but because the colors of the real world are so dull compared to the vibrant coral reefs in Lullely's dreams."

Lullely is a purple rarity Tatari.

== Appearance ==
A crying, blue jellyfish with purple/pink accents. It has a flower pattern on its face, and its tears are always flowing and almost looks like eyes. However, its actual eyes are the dark lines, as we can see in one of animations.

== Evolution Trial ==
Lullely's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Yawnelly]] you need to complete the following task:
* Purchase any 5 [[Decorations|buildings]]. Revamp your Camp!

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Lullely once dreamed of being an astronaut! But sleeping through tryouts didn't help. Now Lullely does it in dreams."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Likes to float, yet can doze off at any moment. Lullely's eyes are always red, though whether from sleepiness or crying is anyone's guess."
